mechanism_narrative: The slow improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT from t-3w to t-0w signals rising weekday activity that should continue to feed more retail and recreation visits over the next month. Because RETAIL_REC is still far below baseline but less negative each week, the next four weeks should remain upward-sloping.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improves from -71.1 to -67.4 across the snapshot
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC becomes more negative on average over the next 28 days despite continued week-to-week gains in WORKPLACES or TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated above about +20% while TRANSIT remains near -70%, people substitute toward local errands and neighborhood leisure, which lifts retail and recreation relative to the prior four weeks. This mechanism acts quickly because the substitution happens within days of commuting avoidance.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +20 while TRANSIT stays below -65
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC does not rise within one week in periods where RESIDENTIAL exceeds +20 and TRANSIT remains below -65.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained weakening in PARKS mobility, especially after a prior week-to-week drop, implies less outdoor discretionary activity and more indoor retail substitution in the following month. The effect should be strongest if park visits keep drifting lower while shopping mobility is still deeply depressed.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by at least 3 points from one week to the next
failure_condition: Reject if a new weekly decline in PARKS is followed by flat or lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM keeps recovering while WORKPLACES stays deeply negative, the retail rebound is confined to essential trips and does not generalize to discretionary retail. Under that pattern, RETAIL_REC should remain below its recent average rather than accelerate upward over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises but WORKPLACES remains below -50
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES stays around -55 while GROCERY_PHARM improves from -28.7 to -21.3
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though GROCERY_PHARM improves while WORKPLACES stays below -50.

mechanism_narrative: A positive one-week change in TRANSIT is an early signal of returning footfall to shopping districts, so retail and recreation should improve within the next two weeks. The mechanism fails if transit stabilizes without a corresponding pickup in retail outings.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next two weeks after two consecutive weekly improvements in TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains high and GROCERY_PHARM improves at the same time, households are concentrating errands locally and reducing destination shopping trips, which suppresses retail and recreation. This should lower RETAIL_REC over the next month relative to the prior month.
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and GROCERY_PHARM continues to improve.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold break in WORKPLACES above its recent level marks a broader relaxation in movement constraints, and retail and recreation should follow with a lag of about one week. The signal is strongest once WORKPLACES improves enough to cut the gap to baseline materially.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by 2 or more points week-on-week
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC fails to improve within one week after WORKPLACES posts a weekly gain of 2 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: In a winter-like low-discretionary-mobility regime, weakening PARKS alongside still-depressed TRANSIT means fewer mixed-purpose trips and more home-centered activity, which should keep retail and recreation below its recent mean. The mechanism depends on both leisure and commuting channels moving in the same direction.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is negative and fell from -17.7 to -25.6 before partial recovery
failure_condition: Reject if RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks while PARKS weakens and TRANSIT remains near its current depressed level.
